sloka: ज्वलनेन परीतानि तोरणानि चकाशिरे।विद्युद्भिरिव नद्धानि मेघजालानि धर्मगे ।। ६.७५.२१ ।।
transliteration: jvalanena parītāni toraṇāni cakāśire।vidyudbhiriva naddhāni meghajālāni dharmage ।। 6.75.21 ।।

translations.english: The fire consumed the houses which were strong and impenetrable, with many enclosures, magnificent ones, constructed in gold in the shape of a half moon and full moon, windows endowed with wonderful pictures. All over the rooms were high on top, decorated with gems, and as if touching the Sun. It was rendered noisy with notes of herons and peacocks, playing of Veena, and jingling of ornaments like the vibration of sounds. The dwellings which looked like mountains were consumed by fire.
